about_the_game:
The unattended train is on it’s way and might run someone over - is it going to be you?

//Features

  • Customizable round-based gameplay against AI or other player

  • Quick sessions with replayability

  • Be strategic or just rely on your luck with decisions

  • Dark and daunting atmosphere to keep you out of your comfort zone

  • The incoming train is not the only danger here...

  • Be one of the two unlucky souls that will end up on the wrong track deep in the subway tunnels

  • Be smart or lucky enough to guess the numbers game to send the unstoppable train towards your opponent

  • Constant virus attacks will require you to be quick with your decisions

  • And a certain entity will make sure you don't feel lonely in this dire situation

//Objectives

  • Guess the next number that you think the game will pick randomly

  • Adjust the route so that the train runs over opponent

  • If you guessed the closest to the actual number, your adjustment will be accepted; if not, the train might be heading towards you now

//Dangers

  • Random power outages can interfere with your ability to pick and adjust; better be a fast thinker to stay safe

  • Random virus attacks might end your game early if you don’t pay enough attention to removing the viruses

  • The same goes for the entity that comes from the depths of the tunnel. Your ears will help you counter this danger; listen to the steps, and check behind your back

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Any modern CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

Recommended:

short_description: Find yourself deep in the subway tunnels with a train rapidly approaching your location. Will you be able to redirect it? Oh, and you're not alone here...
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
